newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Powerful earthquake rocks northeast Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Powerful earthquake rocks northeast Colombia.

text.p: A powerful earthquake jolted northeast Colombia on Wednesday but authorities said it occurred deep beneath the earth's surface and no deaths or injuries were reported.

The quake, centred in a mountainous area about 25 miles (40 km) southeast of Bucaramanga, the capital of northern Santander province, struck at 2:07 a.m. local time (0707 GMT), a spokesman for the National Seismological Institute said.

He said the quake was powerful enough to cause severe damage in a populated area, and was felt across a large area of northern and central Colombia. But its potential for destruction was limited by the fact that it occurred nearly 100 miles (160 km) below the earth's surface.
